fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (NYSE:TSM) Wedbush price target is NT$3,300, confirmed strength with October sales record of NT$58.689 billion (YoY +59.7%).
fields.summary_ko.1: Cumulative sales for the first 10 months of this year reached NT$4.49 trillion, up 43.3% compared to the same period last year, with approximately 13% quarterly annualized growth expected in Q4.
fields.summary_ko.2: Actual exchange rate (32.8) has been weaker than Q4 planned rate assumption (31.8), with approximately 0.4% impact on operating margin per 1% exchange rate change.
